title: Retrotransposons are co-opted to activate hematopoietic stem cells and erythropoiesis | Science
content: Hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) and erythropoiesis are activated during pregnancy and after bleeding by the derepression of retrotransposons, including endogenous retroviruses and long interspersed nuclear elements. Retrotransposon transcription ...
